author: Floyd Anible
text: Premier has taken care of our plumbing needs for three years and never disappointed!  Steve Senior responded quickly to our water heater problem, diagnosed it, and Steve Junior was back the next day with a new heater, on time, congenial, and efficient.  I'm a retired career Air Force former NCO and officer and I can spot a top-notch team of true professionals (including Lisa, the friendly voice on the phone) when I see one!  Installation was quick, "Junior" patiently answered our questions, and did a thorough cleanup.  All for a very reasonable price. Our new water heater is great!  Got plumbing issues? Call Premier Plumbing!

author: Arron Greene
text: These guys did a great job with the repairs we needed! The price was right, the crew were professional, and the owner, Steve, quoted and got the job done right, on time, and in the quoted amount. I would highly recommend Premier Plumbing!

author: Benjamin Ulliman
text:
Junior did a great job replacing my sump pump the day that it went out. He was professional and courteous, and came out on a Saturday at a moments notice. He got the job done right the first time.

I’d recommend junior to anyone in need of a lifetime plumber.

Thanks junior!

author: rachel millsap
text: Junior did a great job replacing my water heater. When an issue arose, he made adjustments as needed until the job was done. Thank you for doing a great job!

author: Moses Zamarron
text: Had Premier replace a PRV and make some water softener adjustments for us. Both Techs, Carlos and Paul Castillo were very professional and knowledgeable. Did an awesome job. Well worth the money.
